moments.title: Premier League Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season begins this Friday, August 21st, with defending champions Arsenal hosting newly-promoted Coventry City.

source.l: Premier League Official Site / Al Jazeera

angles.name: Opening Weekend Buzz
angles.copy: It's back! The Premier League returns this Friday. Who are you backing for glory this season?

angles.name: Coventry's Return
angles.copy: Coventry City are back in the top flight for the first time in 25 years, kicking off against champions Arsenal. Big ask, but what a moment for the Sky Blues!

moments.title: England vs Pakistan First Test
moments.blurb: England's Test cricket summer continues as they face Pakistan in the First Test match, running from August 19-23.

angles.name: Live Cricket Action
angles.copy: The First Test between England and Pakistan is underway! Who's making the early impact in what promises to be a gripping series?

angles.name: Test Match Drama
angles.copy: Five days of Test cricket ahead! Will England dominate on home soil or can Pakistan spring a surprise?

moments.title: European Athletics Championships Wrap-Up
moments.blurb: The European Athletics Championships concluded in Birmingham on August 16th, with champions crowned and British athletes delivering golden moments.

angles.name: Birmingham's Golden Week
angles.copy: What a week of athletics in Birmingham! The European Championships delivered incredible performances and new records. What was your highlight?

angles.name: British Successes
angles.copy: Still buzzing from the European Athletics Championships! Big shout out to all the British athletes who brought home medals.

moments.title: Creamfields Festival Approaches
moments.blurb: The massive dance music festival Creamfields returns to Daresbury, Cheshire, from August 27-30, featuring headliners like Swedish House Mafia, Calvin Harris, and Disclosure.

angles.name: Creamfields Countdown
angles.copy: Who's ready for Creamfields? The countdown is on for a huge weekend of dance music in Daresbury!

angles.name: Festival Line-up
angles.copy: Swedish House Mafia, Calvin Harris, Disclosure... the Creamfields line-up is stacked! Who are you most excited to see?

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals Weekend
moments.blurb: The twin Reading & Leeds Festivals take place from August 27-30, with headliners including Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, and Fontaines D.C.

angles.name: Reading & Leeds Excitement
angles.copy: Reading and Leeds Festivals are just over a week away! Are you heading to Richfield Avenue or Bramham Park?

angles.name: Headliner Hype
angles.copy: From Charli XCX to Fontaines D.C., the Reading & Leeds headliners are huge! Which stage will you be at?

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's Chart Record
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' has made history, spending a record-breaking 21 non-consecutive weeks at UK No. 1.

angles.name: Chart History Made
angles.copy: 21 weeks at No.1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean have officially made chart history with 'Rein Me In'. An incredible achievement!

angles.name: Longest Running No.1
angles.copy: Who expected 'Rein Me In' to become the UK's longest-running No.1 single ever? What a track from Sam Fender & Olivia Dean!

moments.title: Madonna & Kylie Minogue New Top 10
moments.blurb: Pop legends Madonna and Kylie Minogue have teamed up for 'Love Sensation', which debuted at number 8 on the UK Singles Chart.

angles.name: Pop Royalty Collab
angles.copy: Madonna and Kylie Minogue in the Top 10 together! 'Love Sensation' is pure pop royalty. Are you loving it?

angles.name: New Chart Entry
angles.copy: A brand new entry in the Top 10 from two icons! Madonna & Kylie's 'Love Sensation' is making waves.

moments.title: Vanity Fair Premieres on BritBox
moments.blurb: The classic 19th-century drama 'Vanity Fair', starring Olivia Cooke as Becky Sharp, becomes available to stream on BritBox today, August 19th.

angles.name: New Period Drama
angles.copy: Step back in time today! 'Vanity Fair' is now streaming on BritBox. Who's ready for some Becky Sharp ambition?

angles.name: What To Watch Today
angles.copy: Looking for a new binge? 'Vanity Fair' drops on BritBox today. Perfect for fans of classic literature and sharp wit.

moments.title: The Voice UK Returns
moments.blurb: A new series of 'The Voice UK' is set to premiere this Saturday, August 22nd, at 7pm on ITV1.

angles.name: The Voice Is Back
angles.copy: Get ready to turn your chairs! A brand new series of The Voice UK starts this Saturday on ITV1. Who do you hope to see on the judging panel?

angles.name: Weekend TV Plans
angles.copy: Saturday night sorted! The Voice UK kicks off its new season. Will you be tuning in for the blind auditions?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Ian Gillan

angles.name: Rock Legend Birthday

angles.name: Hard Rock Icon
angles.copy: 81 years young! Happy Birthday to Ian Gillan, a true hard rock legend. Still rocking after all these years!

angles.name: Voice of a Generation

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Weekend Approaching

moments.title: Back To School Prep Underway
moments.blurb: While some Scottish schools have already returned, many families across England and Wales are now preparing for children to go back to school in early September.

angles.name: Back To School Rush
angles.copy: The back-to-school scramble is officially on for many! Uniforms, stationery, packed lunches... what's on your list?

angles.copy: For parents everywhere, the countdown to September and the return to school is real! How are you feeling about the end of the summer break?
